From housing support to healthcare services and Veteran employment  this event connects Veterans with essential resources to improve their quality of life.   VA Ann Arbor Healthcare representatives will be on hand to help Veterans  their families  and caregivers apply for  understand  and make the most of their VA healthcare benefits. There will be plenty of helpful information available on different healthcare services  specialties  and programs – including the PACT Act and other VA benefits.
